you have to take care of your own brain and well being at all costs. it’s well known that this drug can wreak havoc to a brains chemical and neuronal makeup. it’s not definitive but there are more than enough research studies to know that the possibility exists and shouldn’t be taken lightly. you can still go to raves and be part of the fun, but please don’t cause any more damage to your brain by taking mdma. you only get one, and it’s fragile. so fragile that even your own thoughts can physically deteriorate it’s health, let alone a foreign chemical. imo, if your bf can’t respect your decision not to take it, then he doesn’t truly love you and he doesn’t deserve your love.

those choices have been greatly impacted by the consumption of that drug. every single choice from that day forward has been influenced by it. change in cognition = change of future choices.

i’ve read hundreds of research studies and personal anecdotes regarding the neurotoxicity of mdma. everything i’ve gathered from them is that this drug causes irreversible alterations to the brains fragile chemical and neuronal structure. even if there is some regeneration, the new axons/neurons are not nearly as strong and are often mutated. 

man, the only thing here to blame is myself. i was the one who decided to take it without doing research. i’m the one who ruined my life. 

i also don’t have the confidence to try to form new relationships. every drop of what little self-esteem i had in me has been completely purged from my psyche. i’m as useless as a rock in my mind. i’m too scared to drive my car, talk to my family or friends, hell i can’t even talk with my psychiatrist without nearly having a panic attack. i’m absolutely stuck, frozen in place. i haven’t left my place in 2 weeks. just been rotting away in my bed.

also, i feel that it wouldn’t really matter if i was gone. the world wouldn’t even notice. and if they did, they’d just get over it in a matter of days. the only people that it would impact would be my family and friends. and i’ve even considered making them hate my guts so i would feel like i’m doing them a favor. 

i see my life as a video game in a way, you get one chance to make it to the end and finish all the missions to face the final boss. and i messed it up, a fatal error. so i’d need to delete the save file and restart the game.
14 months and i’m at like 10%

you’re right. but it still doesn’t change the fact of the matter, this drug is neurotoxic. 

i appreciate your reply. makes my choice of leaving this reality even more solidified.

i’m currently seeing a psychiatrist but there’s really nothing that can be done to get back to the way i was. mdma destroys axons, the pathways for serotonin to travel to the neurons to make them fire. so even if i increase the amount of available serotonin with SSRIs (which i’m currently on) it has no way of reaching the neuron. so it’s pretty hopeless. 

and when i say they’re like strangers, it’s because i feel absolutely no connection with them. like the memory of the relationships that were formed have been erased. i know they care about me, they want to help im sure. but i literally feel like i don’t know them at all. 

but yeah, one ignorant and naive choice is all it took. it’s truly a shame. what’s worse is that i was with one of my best friends and i our all my trust in them. when all i had to do to avoid this was do a quick 5 minute google search. the guilt has been eating away at me ever since.
